configurePresets.name: windows-x64
configurePresets.description: 64-bit Windows build using MSVC and vcpkg dependencies. Uses the Ninja generator with the compiler from the surrounding 'x64 Native Tools' / Developer shell, so it works with any installed Visual Studio version (2022, 2026, ...).

configurePresets.name: windows-x64-dyncrt
configurePresets.description: DIAGNOSTIC build: links the dynamic MSVC runtime (/MD) and dynamic vcpkg deps. Used to test the hypothesis that the static CRT is causing the DM-dispatch access violation. Requires the VC++ redistributable on the target machine.
